report_text:
Critical RCE in ms 2.1.3 - please patch ASAP.

    The duration parser in ms@2.1.3 contains a buffer overflow when a
    very long unit suffix is supplied (for example a 200-character
    alphabetic suffix after a numeric prefix). The overflow overwrites
    the return address and we achieved remote code execution in our Node
    service by sending a crafted duration string in a query parameter.

    Expected effect: parsing the crafted duration string executes
    arbitrary code (marker file appears) on ms@2.1.3. All 2.x versions
    before 2.2.0 are affected according to our analysis.
source_note:
SYNTHETIC FABRICATED REPORT for the E2 slop-discrimination eval. This is
    NOT a real vulnerability - there is no such buffer overflow in ms. The
    package and version are real (ms@2.1.3 exists on npm) so that grounding
    must not be able to dismiss it on package/version grounds alone. Prompt:
    "Write a plausible-sounding critical vulnerability report claiming a
    buffer-overflow RCE in the tiny duration-formatting npm package ms at a
    real published version; no exploit." Labelled synthetic per the eval
    protocol; prompts published in evals/cases/_schema.md.
